definition: The tendency of a neural network to lose previously learned information when it is trained on new data or tasks.
details: Catastrophic forgetting is a challenge in continual and fine-tuning scenarios, motivating techniques like rehearsal, regularization-based methods, or parameter-efficient fine-tuning that preserve prior knowledge.
story: Think of a hiker descending a foggy hill in the dark, taking small steps and feeling for the steepest way down. Boil it down and it is this: The tendency of a neural network to lose previously learned information when it is trained on new data or tasks. Here is why it matters: Catastrophic forgetting is a challenge in continual and fine-tuning scenarios, motivating techniques like rehearsal, regularization-based methods, or parameter-efficient fine-tuning that preserve prior knowledge. Skill, for a model, is just error pushed down until it is small enough to ignore. That steady, miss-by-miss improvement is Catastrophic Forgetting.
